brief: A resort-town cottage lot: G.A. Boeckling House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the G. A. Boeckling House (Sandusky, 1910s; the Cedar Point magnate): a two-storey flat-roofed stucco villa with heavy cartouches and garlands, pilasters, a bracketed canopy over the door; now offices with a monument sign and a flagpole; red-painted concrete steps and edging
